# Workitem 07 — Create Label Propagation Week

## Purpose

When Swamy reaches semi-supervised learning, create a fresh four-layer week bundle for label propagation.

## Scope

- Build content under the active `src/weekN/` structure only.
- Use preserved reference material only as background reading.
- Do not copy archived notebooks or examples.

## Target Bundle

- `src/weekN/01-notes/label-propagation.md`
- `src/weekN/02-quizzes/label-propagation-quiz.md`
- `src/weekN/03-notebooks/label-propagation-implementation.ipynb`
- `src/weekN/04-discussions/label-propagation-discussion.md`

## Acceptance Criteria

- Notes explain labelled vs unlabelled data, graph intuition, propagation, and stopping criteria.
- Quiz questions test both conceptual and numeric understanding.
- Notebook demonstrates a small from-scratch graph-based propagation loop.
- Discussion uses an original scenario where labels are expensive.
- CI and markdown lint pass.
